Name: Aesthetic Ores for Content Patcher
Author: XxHarvzBackxX
Description:
Do you want to play Stardew Valley with more 'Aesthetic' Ores? Well look no further, because Aesthetic Ores does just that! Aesthetic Ores reskins all ore-related objects to be prettier, with nicer colours, but while still following the original Stardew Valley style!

[size=3][b]Copper[/b], the boring, bland, and ugly brown colour, becomes a pretty [b]peppermint green[/b], resembling an oxidised version of copper.
[b]Iron[/b], the dull colour, becomes a beautiful, shiny, [b]periwinkle[/b] colour!
[b]Gold[/b], the unoriginal, drab colour, becomes an adorable [b]rose gold[/b] colour!
[b]Iridium[/b], the pathetic, dry colour, becomes a beautiful [b]pastel purple[/b]![/size]

[center]﻿[/center][center][size=6][b]How to Install[/b][/size]
[size=4]1. Download the mod files on the files tab.
[/size][size=4]2. Drag the '[CP] Aesthetic Ores' folder into your Stardew Valley mods folder.
3. Install [/size][size=4][url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] if you haven't already.
4. Play with your new beautiful ores and tools, and enjoy!
5. Endorse the mod if you enjoy it![/size]
[size=3]﻿[/size]
[/center]
